name: Kingdom Force
description: A 3D-animated action series for kids ages 3-6, KINGDOM FORCE follows the fast-paced exploits of five mighty animal heroes as they serve and protect the citizens of five unique animal kingdoms.

videos.title: Runaway Train
videos.overview: Kingdom Force must rescue Hoover and Professor Dunbit from a speeding train

videos.title: Forecast: Chaos
videos.overview: Jabari accidentally sends a weather drone into overdrive, causing extreme weather shifts to endanger the Five Kingdoms.

videos.title: Fire on Wolf Mountain
videos.overview: While the Wolf and Bear communities argue over ownership of the new bridge that connects their two villages, Kingdom Force must work to save some Camper Cubs from a raging forest fire

videos.title: Go with the Floe
videos.overview: Kingdom Force must save a family of bears from going Titanic after Jalopi sets them adrift on an ice floe.

videos.title: Sinkhole or Swim
videos.overview: Kingdom Force is called to fix-up a sinkhole at The Anopolis, but run into trouble when Liberty, Willow, and Luka get stuck inside of it

videos.title: Drop it like its Hot      TV-G
videos.overview: Kingdom Force has to evacuate and save the citizens of Black Rock Village from an erupting volcano.

videos.title: Danger in Grizzly Valley
videos.overview: Kingdom Force has to reconcile the feuding Bear and Badger communities, while saving the Bear citizens from a collapsing dam

videos.title: Gondola with the Wind
videos.overview: Kingdom Force must save a gondola full of Bears from falling.

videos.title: Bee Yourself
videos.overview: Kingdom Force must caravan honey bees between kingdoms to save an endangered flower

videos.title: Creepy Crawler
videos.overview: Sprocket decides to take the day off, but how can she rest when Dr. Sabre has stolen the Crawler?

videos.title: Origins pt. 1
videos.overview: With a series of odd natural disasters threatening the livelihood of the 5 Kingdoms, a new team of champions is formed - Kingdom Force. But can the members learn to put aside their individual prejudices in order to work together and save all 5 Kingdoms before it's too late?

videos.title: Origines pt.2
videos.overview: With a series of odd natural disasters threatening the livelihood of the 5 Kingdoms, a new team of champions is formed - Kingdom Force. But can the members learn to put aside their individual prejudices in order to work together and save all 5 Kingdoms before it's too late?

videos.title: We Be Jammin
videos.overview: Dr. Sabre's new harvesting robot is picking the Jungle Kingdom orchard clean of Banana Squash

videos.title: Dog Daze
videos.overview: Luka seeks King Cat's help in learning how to relax.

videos.title: Can You Dig It?
videos.overview: A cave in during the Big Dig Festival traps the badger community underground, but how can Kingdom Force set them free?

videos.title: Howl-o-Ween
videos.overview: Kingdom Force must protect the town from a giant Mutant Pumpkin running rampant

videos.title: Funbit 9000
videos.overview: When Professor Dunbit's latest invention malfunctions, it's up to Kingdom Force to save themselves from...the Crawler?!

videos.title: Iron Ape
videos.overview: Maggie Pye steals the gold banana crown when Dalilah abandons her post.

videos.title: Ruin of Zoom
videos.overview: Kingdom force must save the trapped news tram and Professor Dunbit in an ancient ruin.

videos.title: Night Birds
videos.overview: It's a race against time after Envie Fernandez steals the Plains Kingdom's cherished night birds.

videos.title: Mad Max Volume
videos.overview: Kingdom Force must save some frightened felines after Max Volume hijacks the Rocket Train and threatens their safety

videos.title: Big Cat Blues
videos.overview: Kingdom Force must stop an oversized statue of Jabari after Funbit 9000 takes possession of it and wants to play (in a most catastrophic way)!

videos.title: Stink 'em Up
videos.overview: Kingdom Force must track Stink Cactus spores across the Five Kingdoms and contain them before they sprout!

videos.title: The Night Beast of Gorilla Gulch
videos.overview: The team investigates mysterious sightings of a monster around Gorilla Gulch.

videos.title: Free Prize in Every Box
videos.overview: A new cereal craze has the Five Kingdoms in a frenzy searching for the prized Golden Toy, and when Envie Fernandez hijacks a convoy of cereal trucks for herself, it's up to Kingdom Force to stop her and get them back!

videos.title: Sloppy Jalopi
videos.overview: After a botched scheme by Jalopi results in Funbit 9000 taking control of her vehicle and running off with her and Liberty Longtail, the team must chase them through the Ice Kingdom.

videos.title: Full Moon Fever
videos.overview: Kingdom Force must rescue some wolf cubs from a runaway hot-air balloon

videos.title: Super Jalopi!
videos.overview: Kingdom Force must take a back-seat after a newly super powered Jalopi becomes the Five Kingdoms' go-to hero.

videos.title: Hello Dolly
videos.overview: It's up to Kingdom Force to peacefully resolve a dispute between Jalopi and the Rock Monster.

videos.title: Say Yes to the Mess
videos.overview: Kingdom Force needs to stop an out-of-control cleaning machine before it obliterates everything!

videos.title: Snowballs of Fury
videos.overview: When Jabari's bragging gets too much for Artie to handle, he decides to take drastic measures to beat Jabari at his own game, unintentionally creating a massive snowball of destruction in the process!

videos.title: Cat Me if You Can
videos.overview: Jabari's solo-mission is thwarted after Mittens McGuirk intervenes and accidentally lets the Gunter & Gustav steal Jabari's crystal cargo! Will Kingdom Force and Mittens be able to reclaim the crystals before the Henchbears gets away?

videos.title: Ready, Set, Slow!
videos.overview: After Envie Fernandez is quick to steal Professor Dunbit's slo-mo ray, it's up to Kingdom Force to hurry up and get it back before she embarks on an unstoppable crime spree!

videos.title: Ground Breakin', Earth Shakin', No Fakin'
videos.overview: Luka is annoyed after Max Volume repeatedly cries wolf, but what happens when the threat is real and Max really does need help? Will Kingdom Force answer the call?

videos.title: Control Yourself
videos.overview: Max Volume hypnotizes the badger community to do his bidding, leaving no badger unaffected...including TJ! Will Kingdom Force be able to save the day with one of their own working against them?

videos.title: Codes of Trouble
videos.overview: When the crystal-mining robots that Professor Dunbit creates out of old Sabre tech go haywire, Kingdom Force must shut them down before they destroy the Jungle Kingdom!

videos.title: Chill or Be Chilled
videos.overview: Kingdom Force 'defend' a Bear Village from an Ice Monster, but what if the newly discovered creature isn't the enemy they assume it is?

videos.title: Gimme a Break
videos.overview: Jalopi finally forms her own super-team...full of Jalopi clones

videos.title: Under Pressure
videos.overview: Jabari resigns his Kingdom Force spot to legendary hero Mittens McGuirk

videos.title: License to Drill
videos.overview: TJ is irked when he's told to train the other Kingdom Force members how to use his vehicle.

videos.title: Norvyn Not-So-Big
videos.overview: Big problems follow the team after a shrink ray zaps everything in sight...including Kingdom Force themselves! Will the tiny heroes be able to complete their mission, or will their new statures lead to a massive defeat?

videos.title: Skate Expectations
videos.overview:
Skate Expectations

Luka is too embarrassed to admit that he doesn't know how to skateboard, but he'll have to own up to the truth and try his best when a destructive stunt-gone-wrong by Max Volume wreaks havoc in the Canyon Kingdom!

videos.title: Moustivus
videos.overview: When Jabari takes a practical joke too far and pranks Dr. Sabre on TV, it's the Plains Kingdom who'll end up paying the price! Can the team stop Dr. Sabre's misdirected revenge before it's too late?

videos.title: Outfoxed
videos.overview: Envie Fernandez has her eyes on King Cat's crown, and only Sprocket can keep her from getting it. Can she do it without the team?

videos.title: Burden of Tooth
videos.overview: Max Volume's shooting his latest music video, and it's a wild one - so wild that there's an actual tornado wreaking havoc in the Forest Kingdom! Can Kingdom Force shut down production before Max's 'Rocknado' tears the forest apart?

videos.title: Alpha-Magnet
videos.overview: Jalopi's feelings are hurt after she overhears Dalilah talking about her behind her back, and when the team gets in trouble facing off against an electro-magnetic storm, only she can help them - but will she?

videos.title: Fleas & Thank You
videos.overview: Sprocket sends the team on a treasure hunting training mission, but where there's treasure there's often Envie, and she's itching to get the treasure for herself!

videos.title: Cold Comfort
videos.overview: Hoover feels ignored by Kingdom Force and agrees to help Dr. Sabre, but regrets his decision when the Cold-erpillar puts the Alpha-Mech on ice! How can the team defeat Dr. Sabre when he knows about the Alpha-Mech's greatest weakness?!

videos.title: Growing, Growing, Gone
videos.overview: Dr. Sabre uses Dalilah's Grow-Grow Potion to became gigantic and wreaks havoc like only a massive, oversized cat can!

videos.title: Ain't No Level High Enough
videos.overview: Professor Dunbit & Hoover are trapped atop Polar Peak Mountain in a snowstorm.

videos.title: See Cat Run
videos.overview: Kingdom Force are on duty to protect Mayor Honeyclaw's key

videos.title: Throw Norvyn From The Train
videos.overview: Artie is trapped inside of a Funbit-possessed rocket train, and it's up to Kingdom Force to save the day.
